title: Lost (realdemo - cinematic audio test)
logline: A kid survives a storm at sea, washes up on an island, and finds out he is not alone.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The storm came out of nowhere.
beats.visual: night sea, tiny boat climbing a black wave, lightning whites out the frame

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: One wave, and the boat was gone.
beats.visual: underwater, muffled, bubbles, the boat's light sinking away

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I woke up on a beach I'd never seen.
beats.visual: grey dawn, wet sand, waves dragging pebbles back

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: No boat. No dad. Just rain.
beats.visual: rain hitting the sea surface, the jungle edge behind

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So I walked into the trees.
beats.visual: under the canopy, heavy rain on giant leaves, mud

beats.speaker: narr
beats.visual: slow turn, trees thrashing in the wind, nothing there

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I didn't look back. I just ran.
beats.visual: handheld run through the trees, branches whipping the lens

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Into a cave, where the rain couldn't reach me.
beats.visual: cave mouth, the storm outside, drips glinting in the dark

beats.speaker: narr
beats.visual: close on a cracked walkie-talkie, its tiny light flickering

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I made a fire, and thought about home.
beats.visual: small fire, wet face, orange light, rain beyond the cave mouth

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: All night, the jungle was never quiet.
beats.visual: black jungle, eyes? no - just frogs. maybe.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: At sunrise, I found footprints in the sand. Not mine.
beats.visual: low angle on bare footprints leading out of the sea... and into the trees
